name: Kuroki Kazumasa
source:
Kensuke's superior at his new workplace and Sanae's husband.

He loves business entertainment and mahjong, and sometimes spends so much time attending business gatherings that he neglects his wife. He gets drunk quickly.

Although his primary reason for doing so is simply that he enjoys his work, he has also grown somewhat bored with his wife.

Consequently, their married life is rather passionless.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11700]the official site[/url]]
